## MC Hoster 2.0 · The Config Update

### New tab: 6. Config
Everything else about your server, in one place (click Apply & restart after changing it). Only what you change is written; the rest stays the Minecraft default.
- **World**: server list message (MOTD, with & colours), seed, world type (Normal, Flat, Large Biomes, Amplified), structures, view and simulation distance, spawn protection, world border.
- **Players**: PvP, allow flying, force game mode, whitelist (with the names to let in), kick AFK players, hide who's online, command blocks, extra ops.
- **Game rules**: keep inventory, mob griefing, fire spread, day/night, weather, phantoms, mob spawning, natural regeneration, fall damage, instant respawn, advancements in chat, and how many players must sleep. They work on old and new Minecraft versions (the newest versions renamed them).
- **Performance**: how much memory the server gets, and Aikar's flags for smoother memory clean-up.
- **Auto restart**: restart every few hours (players get a warning 5 minutes, 1 minute and 10 seconds before), and start it again by itself after a crash (up to 3 times in 10 minutes).

### Settings tab
- **Resource pack**: find one on **Modrinth** (search right in MC Hoster), paste a **CurseForge** link, or use any direct link. Tick "Players must use it" to make it required, and write the message players see. MC Hoster works out the file's SHA-1 so Minecraft only downloads it again when it changes.
- **Draw your icon**: the new **Draw…** button next to the icon opens a 64×64 drawing board: pencil, eraser, fill, colour picker, 24 colours and any other colour, brush sizes, undo, a colour or gradient background, and 12 ready-made pictures (Sword, Pickaxe, Diamond, Heart, Apple, Grass Block, Shield, Crown, Star, Potion, Fire, Coin) in 4 sizes.

### Plugins & Mods tab
- **Folders**: the presets are sorted into folders (Dark plugins, Admin & permissions, Protection & anticheat, Chat voice & looks, World & building, Maps, Performance, Cross-play & versions, Economy). Click a folder to open or close it; each shows how many are ticked.
- **12 new presets** from Modrinth (Hangar when Modrinth has no build): TAB, DecentHolograms, Multiverse-Core, PlaceholderAPI, GrimAC, squaremap, SkinsRestorer, Maintenance, FastAsyncWorldEdit, ViaBackwards, WorldGuard and ChunkyBorder.
